This occurs on Android 16 with OrbitCook app 4.8.3 on my Pixel 10, while the kettle reports firmware 2.1.7. I am in Denver, and my name is Marisol Vega if that helps locate the account.

Starting from the home screen, I go to Settings, Accounts, Add Profile, enter the email address, and choose Continue; the loading circle remains on screen until I unplug the hub. I tried with two different valid accounts and can reproduce it after a factory reset. The hub is running system build 9.7.14, connected by Ethernet, and the issue occurs on my Samsung QN90D television through HDMI 2. My name is Theo Bennett and I am using it in Austin.

In the VoltNest app, I select the charger, open Battery Care, set the limit to 80%, and turn on Overnight Limit; after that, plugging in my phone makes the LED blink amber and no charge begins. Turning the setting back off immediately lets the same cable and phone charge again. The charger firmware is 1.9.6, the app is VoltNest 5.1.2, and I tested with a Galaxy S26 running Android 16. I live in Phoenix and the affected outlet is a standard grounded indoor wall outlet.

I open the FrameLink app, choose Albums, select my shared album called Family Weekend, enable Auto Sync, and press Sync Now; landscape photos display correctly but every portrait image turns 90 degrees clockwise. I am Keisha Morgan in Minneapolis, and this began after the display's most recent update.

I am in Savannah, and this happens both on Wi-Fi and when I switch to Bluetooth.

The machine firmware is 4.2.8, ClearBrew Home is version 2.7.5, and I am using an iPhone 14 Pro on iOS 18.6. I am Dorian Hale in Milwaukee, and the machine has SKU-CBE-3 printed on its base.

The doorbell runs firmware 11.3.2, and the issue occurs in HaloGuard app 10.6.1 on a Surface Pro 12 running Windows 12. I am based in Newark, and I can reproduce it every evening.

The vacuum has firmware 6.8.9, the app is AeroGlide 9.3.0, and I am using a Motorola Edge 60 on Android 16.
